# Tots & Friends Childcare Centre

> A childcare centre (taska / tadika) in Jenjarom, Selangor, Malaysia,
> operated under Tadika Pelita Ilmuku (TPI). Providing early childhood
> education and care for children aged 0 to 6 years. Play-based learning
> inspired by Reggio Emilia and Montessori approaches.

## Location & Contact
- Address: No. 17, Jalan Jambu Mawar 3, Taman Sri Jarom, 42600 Jenjarom, Selangor, Malaysia

## About
Tots & Friends Childcare Centre was founded in 2018 with just 10 children and a big dream. Today we serve a growing community of families in Jenjarom and the surrounding Selangor area with nurturing, play-based early childhood education. We are part of Tadika Pelita Ilmuku (TPI).

## Programmes
- Infant Care (0-12 months): Supervised care in a warm, nurturing environment with sensory-rich activities
- Toddler Programme: Exploratory learning for early walkers focusing on motor skills, language, and social development
- Preschool: Structured curriculum preparing children for primary school through literacy, numeracy, and creative expression
- The Creative Hive: Arts and creativity-focused enrichment encouraging imagination and self-expression

## Our Values
- Kindness & Empathy
- Curiosity & Exploration
- Inclusivity & Belonging
- Safety & Trust
- Creativity & Joy
- Growth & Resilience

## Philosophy
Child-led, play-powered learning combining Reggio Emilia principles with modern developmental research. We believe learning is something children do naturally when given the right environment.

## History
- 2018: Founded with 10 children
- 2019: Introduced first onsite play-based classroom
- 2020-2022: Transitioned to online classes during the pandemic
- 2023: Reopened with expanded age groups (children as young as 2)
- 2025: Hosted first concert in a full-sized hall
